name: Telecommunications Engineer
description: Implement protocol stacks, signal processing, and network functions. Work with cellular protocols, packet processing, and software-defined radio.
example_snippet:
program PacketParser:
    shape Packet holds:
        Header as whole number
        Payload as byte with values
        Length as whole number
    end shape

    action parse_header takes P as const ref Packet produces whole number:
        # Extract type from upper 16 bits
        keep Type as whole number
        put the right shift of P.Header and 16 into Type
        produce success with Type
    end action

    keep Pkt as Packet with 0x00010002 and nothing and 4
    keep PktType as whole number
    call parse_header with Pkt giving PktType
    print the text "Packet type: " and PktType and newline
end program
status_note: C backend active. Circular buffers and bit manipulation available. DSP/SIMD requires unsafe C imports; dictum_timer.c for interrupt simulation.
